in_marathi.name: Komala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Komala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Komala comes from the Sanskrit word 'kumudā', which means 'moon' or 'moonlight'. It is a feminine name in Hindu tradition and is often associated with beauty, grace, and calmness.

in_bengali.name: Komala
